reason: A DSH plugin-management tool centered on Web UI and CLI automation for installing, updating, toggling, removing, analyzing, and discovering plugins across profiles.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 和 CLI 中管理 DSH 插件，支持安装、更新、启停、卸载、健康分析、环境管理与市场浏览。
summaries.en: Manage DSH plugins through a Web UI and CLI with support for installation, updates, toggling, removal, health analysis, profile management, and marketplace browsing.

capabilities: Provides a Web UI for listing, installing, updating, enabling, disabling, and uninstalling DSH plugins
Provides a CLI for profile-scoped plugin installation, removal, updating, mounting, listing, and analysis
Modifies plugin profiles, patch files, installed packages, and related environment configuration
Performs dependency, conflict, compatibility, and runtime health analysis
Provides a searchable plugin marketplace and update detection
